Question: Which kilometers is highest value and largest values?
target:
<ROUTE>SQL</ROUTE>
<SQL>
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT Major_island,
        CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(Area, 1, INSTR(Area, ' km2') - 1), ',', '') AS REAL) AS area_km2,
        CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(Highest_elevation, 1, INSTR(Highest_elevation, ' m') - 1), ',', '') AS REAL) AS elevation_m
    FROM my_table
    WHERE Area != 'None' AND Highest_elevation != 'None'
)
SELECT 'Largest area: ' || Major_island || ' with ' || area_km2 || ' km²' AS info FROM parsed ORDER BY area_km2 DESC LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Highest elevation: ' || Major_island || ' with ' || elevation_m || ' m' FROM parsed ORDER BY elevation_m DESC LIMIT 1;
</SQL>
<EXECUTION_RESULT>
SQL Error: ORDER BY clause should come after UNION ALL not before
</EXECUTION_RESULT>
